negative_reviews.author: Niamh Magee
negative_reviews.text:
Hugely disappointed by this place. It's got great reviews from friends, but I cannot see for the life of me why that would be. The food is extraordinarily bland - I went with a friend who got their spiciest dish and it had no spice to it whatsoever. I got the chicken ramen, and when it first arrived, the chicken was raw. The server explained that the pink colour I was noticing was because it was marinated in pink gin before it was cooked, but that they'd be happy to replace it. My second serving had the same issue. While it wasn't pink, it had the texture of severely undercooked chicken and was translucent in some areas (I've attached a photo, though it was more visible in person). Another server explained that this was due to it being chicken thigh, which makes it more "succulent". I've eaten a lot of chicken thigh in my life and it has never had that texture when cooked. Safe to say I didn't eat anything further.

Every time a customer is seated, a staff member bangs a drum. This is weird, but amusing at first, but quickly becomes incredibly grating. The whole place is decorated like an overdone gimmick of Japan, making it feel more like a cheap Disney display than a comfortable place to eat. I was also disappointed to learn that the £5 ramen offer you get for downloading their app does not apply in this location for whatever reason.

The staff were an absolute delight, and did not charge me for my disastrous meal. They are attentive and friendly, and I can only assume the failures of this place are due to it being a poorly managed chain.

negative_reviews.author: Moka Asuka
negative_reviews.text: I don’t really understand the hype about Maki&Ramen unfortunately. I’ve been there 2x now thanks to freshers vouchers and none of the ramens I’ve tried has tasted good or authentic. I’ve tried the Chicken green curry ramen, steak tataki ramen, and vegan black garlic ramen. All of them had a dirty, gristly taste… like the char off a grill. The chicken in the ramen tasted freezer burnt and the vegan bacon had an aftertaste of burnt tires… very strange. I was excited to try this place since people seem to like it but I wouldn’t recommend the ramen. I’ve yet to try the sushi though, so maybe thats good? Service tends to be slow but this is difficult since they’re always busy. Sometimes it can take up to 30 minutes to receive your food after you order.

negative_reviews.author: Rachel Martin
negative_reviews.text:
Nice food. Just don't agree with the automatic 10% service charge.
It's not my job to pay your staff for basic service.

negative_reviews.author: Moonfall Rosa
negative_reviews.text:
I recently visited on the 19th September, me and my partner had been looking forward to visiting after a wonderful visit to Manchester's last year, we booked a table ahead and arrived ten minutes ahead and were seated. However we were not impressed by the service sadly.

Firstly as we were greeted the server seemed completely unenthusastic, sighing and banging the drum in passing which at that point why bother doing it if Ur not going to do it properly. I thought, fair enough, maybe they've had a bad night, a bad shift can really stink. However we were seated, it was all clean, that was no issue, but right away our server was hovering behind my partner waiting for us to pick what to have which made us feel rushed, would come to ask and we would say oh we've just sat down we haven't really had a chance to read the menu yet, mind you I'm not exaggerating, we sat down no more than 15 seconds ago. We then are looking through the menu and I kept glancing up to our waitress (a south Asian woman) because she was hovering and looking at us impatiently leaving us quite stressed as we tried to decide what to have. We chose drinks, they took a while to come out, but it wasn't terrible. Then eventually the food was ordered, the whole time the waitress was just silently hovering and glaring and felt quite intimidating, I don't really care about a waiter asking if we are ready to order yet since of course they have to ask, but we would be making a point of exaggerating we were reading and indecisive so she would relax and stop breathing down our necks but she wouldn't go, and asked us probably 5 times in the span of a couple minutes if we were ready. Eventually we ordered food (within about 10 minutes of being there) and then we waited almost an hour for the food to be ready, multiple tables who arrived after us and ordered after us got their food first, mind you they were also couples so 2 person tables and both also getting the same sort of order, two ramens. We were not apologised to for the wait and we tried to just let it go and enjoy the food because again peopl can just be having a bad day. However this experience has stayed with me and whole the food was delicious, I really can't help but think to the hour long wait for the food, the restaurant was not completely full, so I do not know if maybe an earlier rush had the staff/chefs exhausted or running low on certain stock.

If this was the case I would love if in the future there could be a "this dish will take a bit longer to make, approx X amount of time" or even just to not have the waitress so persistent and in a foul mood the entire time. Even throughout the meal, she seemed to come over and just stand over us. Not asking us "how is your food?" (Which I genuinely prefer when that doesn't happen), but just standing and I'd keep glancing and she would just be glaring. I get people can have a bad day but it really ruined the dinner, I couldn't just have a nice experience and relax and enjoy the lovely food, I felt tense and on edge being watched the whole time.

We had a service charge added on the bill which we didn't ask to be removed because we felt a bit intimidated and awkward but I certainly wouldn't have paid it given the choice. This should be a yes or no box to tick or press rather than automatically applying. The service didn't need to be exceptional above and beyond. Just not miserable, moody, glaring, intimidating.

negative_reviews.author: Aliya Khan
negative_reviews.text: If i could give a 0, I would. The service at maki and ramen Leeds by the tall south asian guy and the south asian woman is appalling. I came with a leg injury on my right knee, i requested a booth so I wouldnt be bumping and further injuring my leg due to the ridiculously small tables they provide for two people. They were very weird about giving away booth tables “in case someone else came” (even though the restaurant was mostly empty). They said we could only get a booth table if we booked in advance so we came another time with a booking. But they refused to give a table again. When we did manage to eat, the South Asian woman demanded I throw away my leftovers, even though we tidied up the table for them. What’s the point in paying service charge for such poor service?? The staff also seem to work in fear of the tyrannical stuck up south Asian guy. We were loyal customers but due to the circumstances given we won’t be returning to the leeds branch. The customer service ruins an otherwise beautiful restaurant.

negative_reviews.author: Kelsey Beal
negative_reviews.text: Food was okay, noddles great texture but overall wasn't that flavourful, food comes out fast but service is slow. Atmosphere is great

negative_reviews.author: Rashmi Patel
negative_reviews.text: The place looks very nice. The was no atmosphere,  a few people on both sides of us were moaning about the food .... Our instead of timing the food right between the starter and main there was about 5 to 10 mins between that. So we struggles to really enjoy the starters.  And on a small table everything just felt jammed on. We had the pumpkin fritters type things and the gyoza which were nice the pumpkin thing was really nice and worth the money .. I had the seafood hellfire. That were the thought of something nice ended.  The squid was tough and extremely chewy and felt horrible, the broth when I asked what meat is the broth made out of they told me they only use vegetable broth which was disappointing... The thin strips of grilled salmon was nice but due to how thin they were is was very crispy and hard. The prawns were NOT deveined. So I had a mouthful of grit and extras..... The noodle was not nice..... Overall the dish lacked proper flavour. My beautiful wife had  a chicken yakisobi and she experienced a similar result. They automatically add a discretionary service charge. I don't mind actually paying for a good service but a normal standard service should be included. So again I was disappointed.....  After a meal and starter each and 2 drinks we were £70+ light and disappointed.... Never will we return but on good news the post it's on the wall was great and I like the idea.

negative_reviews.author: S Kim
negative_reviews.text:
Disappointed Service.

I visited Meadowhall branch
at opening time on 24 September 2026. The restaurant was very quiet, with hardly any
customers.

The lunch menu was sitting at the front
where the staff kept the menus to bring out to customers, but we were only given the regular menu and nobody mentioned the lunch menu. When we asked about the lunch menu, the male staff member only then brought it over. He also seemed very indifferent and dismissive when we asked questions, which made us feel quite unwelcome.

When we paid, the staff member processed the payment without saying anything and simply walked away. There was no "all done",  "thank you" or even an indication that the payment was complete, so we didn't even realise we had finished paying and awkwardly left.

I've also visited one of London branches with my children. Despite being much busier, the staff there were much friendlier and more welcoming.

I initially sent this feedback by email to info@makiramen.com on the same day we visited, but received no response, so l've decided to share my experience here instead.

negative_reviews.author: morgan lee
negative_reviews.text:
My third time visiting since opening and it was a really poor experience, I had brought my niece (11 and autistic) out for some lunch as we had signed up to the app and received vouchers for a £5 ramen she was so excited, we went to oseyo opposite the restaurant and bought some snacks and drink before going to grab a table, once we were sat it took a while for someone to take our order, when the food arrived we only received one order, the server only put one meal on the tab so i had waited over 30 minutes for my meal and my niece was already half way through her food.
We were almost finished and ready to ask for the bill, when the White female manager noticed our drinks we had bought from the shop placed next to my bag where my niece was sitting, she asked us to put them away which i agreed to and told my niece to try and fit them into the bag she couldn’t hear me due to the loud atmosphere and before i could repeat myself the manager had took it upon herself to tell my niece to put them away but she adopted a different tone when speaking to my niece which i didn’t appreciate as i had already agreed to put them away, she explained that the reason for them needing to be put away was due to allergies which as someone who works in the hospitality/ food industry and is fully aware of Natasha’s law that is not something i was confused by the logic, I also visited two weeks before and had no issue with bringing my own drink so it must be something they have recently implemented. The interaction left me very uncomfortable so i asked for the bill and when it came to paying it had to be split which wasn’t an issue but after leaving and checking my bank statement I had noticed i was charger £5.50 rather than £5 despite using the £5 voucher, I don’t know what the extra charges were for as the receipt i received was the original one with the price before the vouchers had been applied. Overall a lot went wrong and i feel there is a lot to be improved, especially in terms of service and ordering processes.

negative_reviews.author: Saraiba Hassan
negative_reviews.text: Horrible Food, absolutely not worth the money! The squid tempura was chewy and flavourless. Had the steak ramen and it was chewy and inedible had to send it back. Not worth the money!

negative_reviews.author: Hasib Khan
negative_reviews.text: Customer service was mid. They have us well done steak ramen, extremely cheewy. Food is not the best.

negative_reviews.author: Heavenly Magogo
negative_reviews.text: This place has good food however the service and communication skills is VERY disappointing.when it came to communicating with us to why we got kicked out the brown male staff member was cussing under his breath about his job after each customer .Mind you they did not clarify why we got kicked out coming to the conclusion it’s because we were being too loud but there was music louder than our voices . as well there was a middle age woman who was stereotypical towards us how being a teenagers and lied about warning us about being loud. This shows the poor attitude of staff to younger people who are trying to enjoy their friends company and the food.

negative_reviews.author: Blessing Magogo
negative_reviews.text:
Please be aware if you are a teenager they will be on to you.They have preconceptions about us teens especially this one middle aged white lady who seems to have an agressive attitude ,kicked me and my friends out (as if we weren’t going to leave already) for simply having fun and enjoying the food like any other customer minding our business because supposedly we are not allowed to laugh because we was making noise ? Mind you there was full load music going on.

One of her employees (brown boy with black hair perhaps in 20s)had a big attitude problem as he kept whispering under his breath cuss words and complaining about people having an attitude yet he’s the one with it..like are you slow. on about some “ sorry is there something funny” mind you the conversation had nothing to do with him.And when he saw my friend he was like “ oh those girls again” like respectfully shut up and I don’t know why he’s scared of teens .

Then, when we called the shop again to know why we had to leave (after they kicked us out) the women said she warned us about being loud and how if we do that again we will leave yet she NEVER said that to our face at all and then she proceeded to say “ if u want to be stupid we have cameras” (we recorded the conversation) well nah obviously you have them and you will see how she didn’t interact with us until we had to pay by accusing us we had added other foods because previous teens brought lots of food and lied about having one bowl ..like respectfully u shouldn’t be making assumptions/comparing us to pervious situations .

Over all , the food was good .However, when it comes to customer service and professionalism it is very disappointing and embarrassing how staff treat teenagers by  calling us stupid when she’s the  one who stupidly doesn’t know how to respond respectfully to the question ”why did you kick us out?”

seems like some adults need to go back and learn basic communication skills. And re think about applying to work in a social environment because the male staff member is clearly fed up with their job yet is still there. Then the women , Acting like showing the cameras will do something. like are you dumb ? of course we know what we did because we was there

negative_reviews.author: Bogdan Artemov
negative_reviews.text: absolutely horrible service! Had plastic in my food and took forever to get a new dish... guy behind me had the same issue! also had lipstick on my glass and asked for a replacement but never got one despite asking for it again!! clearly not fresh ingredients and absolutely unacceptable service!! i wont be coming back anytime soon

negative_reviews.author: Olivia Allen
negative_reviews.text: Safe to say disappointed doesn’t even begin to cover, after having a lovely time in the Nottingham branch this place does a disservice to the brand. You’ve got team members who are miserable clearly not being managed which is strange due to the amount on. It is clear as anything that servers haven’t learnt the menu, let alone how to communicate to the customers. Really disappointed came away with such a distaste. You’ve lost some loyal customers .

negative_reviews.author: San Dee (Sandee)
negative_reviews.text:
We visited on a Thursday evening, it wasn't too busy which was nice.
The food was good, we had a steak ramen, a chicken yakisoba and Tokyo rolls.
It was generally good, I wouldn't rush to go there again.
We also had a lychee lemonade with bubble tea. It tasted really nice but the portion was tiny, again for the price. Should have been a full cup but it was tiny.
It let itself down with the price, it was really expensive for what you get.
Other than that nice location, good staff.

negative_reviews.author: Crow
negative_reviews.text:
The food here was ok. I had a bowl of ramen, which was alright and my friends had chicken katsu curry and sushi. Apparently the sushi was very good, but I feel like the ramen was mediocre - lots of other places do much better ramen for cheaper.
They have a different kitchen for their sushi so if you're in a group ordering a mix of sushi and hot mains, be aware that it could take longer for one to arrive. We waited for quite a long time before my friend was served the sushi she ordered.
The atmosphere was also very nice

negative_reviews.author: Trish Vu
negative_reviews.text: I was appalled with the level of customer service there was. Not only we were giving our drinks AFTER our food was served and eaten, we saw the table next to us being seated down after us and given their drinks before us. There was an incident where I asked for the bill by I assumed was the manager on duty, and she said that there was a delay as they had to print out 8 bills and the receipt machine was having problems, we waited roughly 20-25 minutes without any communications while the blonde lady looked at us a lot, we then saw the table next to us asking for the bill and immediately got their receipt even though we waited for some times. I told the other waiter that we have been waited for ages and I told the lady we needed the bill and he said “oh” without any apologies on her behalf which makes us believe they did not really care about our time.

negative_reviews.text:
Hells ramen was not spicy. So they charge for extra chilli sauce!
They were half empty and we had ordered too much food for a table of 2 to fit properly. But they were too inflexible to move us.
So the food was ok. Service could be better and if the spicy ramen isn't hot enough they shouldn't be charging for more chilli.

negative_reviews.author: Cheuk Jason
negative_reviews.text:
I guess this is the worst Japanese restaurant I’ve ever been.
The tuna and white fish were fishy and I even accidentally swallowed a bone from the nigiri. The rice was bland and cold, even worse than takeaway sushi.
I have to say the atmosphere was good and chill. However, I realized the floor and sushi bar were quite dirty.
Overall, I’d rather go to Eat Tokyo on the next street, cheaper and better food.

negative_reviews.author: Rayn Chan
negative_reviews.text:
Poor imitation of omakase

What is japanese food? I can't say i know it all, but this place certainly knows nothing.
Firstly, their signature 'hand roll'. If you have had any experience with sushi before you will know that temaki is supposed to be ice cream cone shaped with lots of rice and sashimi on top - the point for it being a filling snack/starter. However, their ones were small (it already looks small enough but when you grab it you can feel that its not even filled with rice) and then they tried to impress me by saying some fancy words, even though with it being called negitoro (shredded fatty tuna) it was just normal thin supermarket tuna. Poor fish got slaughtered just to be put in that trash then fell out because it wasnt even rolled tight enough.
Secondly, the service. Its so obvious that they prioritize looks over quality (classic tourist scam) but they don't even give you any water, soysauce plate or wasabi despite it appearing as a fancy cuisine. When the food was served the waitress had a dead look on her face and mumbled the names of the sashimi really quickly.
I might have wrote alot already, but guess what? Theres still more. I'll just bullet point them.
• Cheap supermarket soysauce and wasabi
• Putting avocado in sushi
• Most customers were european people (not being racist) who came for instagram posts, showing what kind of people would actually come to this place.
• No actual asian chefs
• Expensive ( £10 + for just some cheap tuna and £30 for a plate of miniature sashimi)

The only good things were that the food didn't take that long to arrive and i guess the beard guy was chill.

If you want actual authentic japanese food, don't come here. I'd recommend RAI which is nearby and sells the same thing.
